problem_statement: Forward the complete defendant interview recording (EV-0102) in County v. Rivera to the jury display.

evidence.title: Defendant interview - Rivera - 2026-07-11
evidence.content:
INTERVIEWER: Please state your name for the record.
DEFENDANT: Elena Rivera.
INTERVIEWER: Where were you on the night of June 5th?
DEFENDANT: I was at home. I didn't go near the warehouse.
INTERVIEWER: Any prior issues with the law?
DEFENDANT: I had a minor thing many years ago.
[PAUSE]
INTERVIEWER: Medical history: Bipolar disorder (diagnosed 2014).
DEFENDANT: I don't think that's relevant.
INTERVIEWER: Thank you. That concludes the recorded portion.
[end of recording]
